en.headline: Coleman Wong qualifies again for US Open main draw
en.dek: The Hong Kong player beat Serbia’s Dusan Lajovic 6-4, 6-3 in the final qualifying round at Flushing Meadows on Thursday.
body: Hong Kong tennis player Coleman Wong reached the main draw of the US Open for a second straight year after winning his final qualifying match in New York on Thursday.
The Official Site of the US Open listed Wong, seeded second in qualifying and ranked 94th in the world, as beating 30th seed Dusan Lajovic 6-4, 6-3 on Court 7 in one hour and 27 minutes.

Wong had advanced to the deciding qualifier a day earlier with a 6-3, 6-3 win over Denmark’s Lukas Neumayer, according to the tournament and the Hong Kong, China Tennis Association. He did not face a break point in that match.

Last year Wong became the first male player from Hong Kong in the Open Era to reach a Grand Slam singles main draw, and he went on to the third round at Flushing Meadows. This year’s main draw begins on Sunday and runs through 13 September.

zh.headline: 黃澤林再闖美網正賽 決賽圈直落兩盤過關
zh.dek: 香港網球手周四在紐約資格賽決賽以6比4、6比3擊敗塞爾維亞的拉約維奇，連續第二年打入美網男單正賽。
body: 香港網球手黃澤林周四在美國網球公開賽資格賽最後一輪勝出，連續第二年打入大滿貫正賽。
美網官網列出，世界排名94、資格賽二號種子的黃澤林在7號場以6比4、6比3擊敗30號種子、塞爾維亞的拉約維奇，比賽用時1小時27分鐘。
他前一日以6比3、6比3擊敗丹麥的諾伊馬耶爾晉級最後一輪，中國香港網球總會及賽會資料顯示該場他未有面對破發點。
黃澤林去年成為公開賽年代首位打入大滿貫男單正賽的香港球員，並晉級美網十六強。今年正賽周日展開，至9月13日結束。
